608      def get_kv_cache_spec(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> KVCacheSpec | None:
 609          # Block size may get updated after model loading, refresh it
 610          block_size = vllm_config.cache_config.block_size
 611          # Encoder-only attention is prefill-only and keeps no autoregressive KV
 612          # cache. In hybrid models (e.g. Qwen3.5 / ColQwen3.5: GatedDeltaNet
 613          # linear_attention interleaved with full_attention) the runner iterates
 614          # every attention module to build the KV-cache spec, so an ENCODER_ONLY
 615          # full_attention layer reaches here; it contributes no KV cache group.
 616          if self.attn_type in (AttentionType.ENCODER_ONLY, AttentionType.ENCODER):
 617              return None
 618          # Should not be called for enc-dec attention.
 619          assert self.attn_type == AttentionType.DECODER

739      def get_kv_cache_spec(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> KVCacheSpec | None:
 740          spec = super().get_kv_cache_spec(vllm_config)
 741          if not self._exports_checkpoints or not isinstance(spec, MambaSpec):
 742              return spec
 743          # FlashInfer emits states at one stride for the whole batch, the gcd of
 744          # the offsets; keeping every offset on the prefix-cache grid keeps that
 745          # stride a multiple of the grid, which bounds the states emitted.
 746          return replace(
 747              spec,
 748              num_prefill_checkpoint_blocks=1,
 749              prefill_checkpoint_alignment=get_mamba_prefill_checkpoint_grid(vllm_config),
 750          )

collect.code:
138  def get_kv_cache_spec(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> dict[str, KVCacheSpec]:
 139      kv_cache_spec: dict[str, KVCacheSpec] = {}
 140      layer_type = cast(type[Any], AttentionLayerBase)
 141      attn_layers = get_layers_from_vllm_config(vllm_config, layer_type)
 142      for layer_name, attn_module in attn_layers.items():
 143          if getattr(attn_module, "kv_sharing_target_layer_name", None):
 144              # This layer will use KV cache of the sharing target layer.
 145              continue
 146          # Skip modules that don't need KV cache (eg encoder-only attention)
 147          if spec := attn_module.get_kv_cache_spec(vllm_config):
 148              if isinstance(spec, AttentionSpec):
 149                  spec = customize_attention_spec(attn_module.get_attn_backend(), spec)
 150              if attn_module.is_draft_layer:
 151                  spec = replace(spec, is_draft=True)
 152              kv_cache_spec[layer_name] = spec
 153      if vllm_config.attention_config.hisparse_config is not None:
 154          kv_cache_spec = resolve_hisparse_specs(vllm_config, kv_cache_spec, attn_layers)
 155      return kv_cache_spec
